location: Results, Confirmatory analysis (PDF p. 9)
quote: I found a highly significant positive interaction between reward and IE, such that greater Stroop interference predicted a larger influence of reward on repeating previous choices (p < .001).
reason: Primary-source p < .001 is compatible with the shipped p < .01 bound under the required interval comparison; a tighter source bound is not a coded error. Prior blind extraction was a different interaction. Audit item 349 already captures the infrequent-condition model-based interaction (b = -.3, p = .6, which blind extracted here), whereas item 350 (with es_type_r = null and a '<' bound) corresponds to the infrequent-condition model-free interaction reported only as p < .001, which shipped misrecorded as < 0.01.

location: 2023 official correction, replacement paragraph for original p.4 right column, fourth full paragraph
reason: Official correction DOI10.1073/pnas.2320273120 explicitly replaces the focal chi-square 24.3 with21.7, matching the shipped statistic. The original primary methods establish N100. Blind extraction preserved the superseded 2017 text; generalized eta squared is a different metric. Direct published correction settles this as an obvious version discrepancy.
